If you are after live music, the Wolf Den is the heart of the property. It is an intimate venue right in the center of the action where you can catch national acts for free, and the energy there is electric once the show starts. 

Since you mentioned food, Comix Roadhouse is a solid choice because they serve a full menu right during their sets. Pro tip: if you want a seat at the Wolf Den, people usually start lining up about an hour before the 8:00 PM showtime, but you can always hear the music from the surrounding lounge area if you prefer to stay mobile.
